response.original_title: 【Room Addition FAQ】 How do I add a room on a Royal Caribbean cruise
response.overview: You can add a room to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruises booking by calling Royal Caribbean Cruise Customer Service at +1-888-315-9585 or contacting your travel agent. To add rooms to a Royal Caribbean Cruise, you must call Royal Caribbean Cruise directly at ☎️ +1-888-315-9585(US/Canada) or +44-808-196-9697(UK) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Additions depend on stateroom capacity, ship lifeboat capacity, and current availability ☎️ +1-888-315-9585(US/Canada) or +44-808-196-9697(UK).
